description: This PHP source file defines the 'Affiliate' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Account' namespace. It contains methods for handling affiliate account functionalities such as viewing and editing affiliate details, saving affiliate information, and interacting with the affiliate system including validation, installation, and updates. The class extends a core Controller class and utilizes models, language translations, session management, and URL routing typical of the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Represents the Affiliate controller handling affiliate registration, editing, and validation processes for the user's affiliate account within OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the affiliate account page, initializes data, and loads necessary views. Handles redirection if the user is not logged in or if token validation fails.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of the affiliate information form, performs validation on the input, updates or creates affiliate records, and manages redirection with success or error messages.
